simple.meaning: לֹא עַמִּי (Lôʼ ʻAmmîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “Lo-Ammi , the symbolic name of a son of Hosea.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לֹא עַמִּי (H3818) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in לֹא עַמִּי (H3818) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: לֹא עַמִּי (Lôʼ ʻAmmîy) / H3818 is traced through Hosea 1:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Lo-Ammi , the symbolic name of a son of Hosea
definitions.full: H3818. Lo Ammi עַמִּי לֹא proper name, masculine ( not my people: see לֹא 2d ) symbolic name of Hosea's son , Hosea 1:9 , compare Hosea 2:25 (see also 2:1 ; 2:3 ).
definitions.rootNote: from 3808 and 5971 with pronominal suffix; not my people ;

occurrences.englishText: He said, “Call his name Lo-Ammi§ Lo-Ammi means “not my people”.; for you are not my people, and I will not be yours.
